issues.description: The problem statement UML defines numberOfInscribedStudents as int, but the solution implementation declares numberOfInscribedStudents as long. This mismatch can cause type and compilation issues (e.g., arithmetic with int fields and an expected int return type for getTotalNumberOfStudents) and will confuse students about the expected attribute type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the attribute type across artifacts. Preferably change the solution's numberOfInscribedStudents from long to int (update the field declaration, constructor parameter, getter/setter, and any related uses) so it matches the UML/problem statement. Alternatively, if large values are intended, update the problem statement and UML to use long and adjust method return types (e.g., getTotalNumberOfStudents) to return long consistently.
